Source Monster

Monster: Malfestio | CR: 9 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

Your weapon has 3 runes. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its runes, and if a secret door or trap is within 30 feet of you, the weapon pulses and points at the one nearest to you. This weapon regains [[/r 1d3]] expended runes daily at dawn.

Armor Effect

You have @variantrule[Advantage|XPHB] on Wisdom (@skill[Perception]) checks that rely on sight while you wear this armor. In conditions of clear visibility, you can make out details of even extremely distant creatures and objects as small as 2 feet across.

Tags: mechanic:rune-charges, mechanic:advantage

activation.condition: Weapon side active — expend 1 rune; pulse toward nearest secret door/trap within 30 ft
